repairs: Whole rotated tank/slab contact replaces center-footprint support search.
Detached columns release their old structural constraint; healthy beams still constrain connected motion.
Resting slabs require an upward contact path to standing or grounded roots; tilted support may have a higher center. Floating cycles cannot become anchors.
Debris rotation bounds are cached; permanent architecture does not increment an unused age field.
Float64 XOR deltas keep every state record with12 instead of20 bytes per changed field.

intermediateFailures.finding: Headless Chrome stopped delivering animation callbacks during a take, then also before recording in a fresh session. JavaScript stayed responsive and WebGL was not lost.
intermediateFailures.resolution: The capture-only --disable-frame-rate-limit launch option restored frame delivery. A moving/held/moving recorder preflight and all final actual-control takes use this setting. Performance samples retain default frame limiting. Failed takes are excluded; no application clock, physical state or video speed was changed.

intermediateFailures.finding: The final collapse recording exposed one slab repeatedly sleeping and waking because its valid tilted support had a higher center.
intermediateFailures.resolution: Require an upward contact path to standing or grounded roots instead of ordering by center height. The exact 11 recorded inputs now form a 30-to-40-second stability regression, independently verified on the final runtime.
Measure impact energy before contact damping. Existing rupture/water assertion retained.

intermediateFailures.finding: Initial whole-slab collision changed velocity during an old velocity fixture.
intermediateFailures.resolution: Observe the same velocity property before collision response; no tolerance weakened.

intermediateFailures.finding: Independent roof-bound probe initially reported25 overlap frames in a nearby edge case.
intermediateFailures.resolution: Correct the probe to rotate its local roof-center offset. Three OBB.applyMatrix4 only translated that existing center. No geometry tolerance loosened.

intermediateFailures.finding: First collapse rehearsal missed a foundation and paused instead of continuing.
intermediateFailures.resolution: A projected target lay over the playback controls. Driver now checks the top DOM element is the canvas and verifies every accepted charge event. The corrected recorded flow reaches99 resting bays.

rebuttal: The reviewed33 standing tower bays are not automatically a defect: foundations51,52,53 remained fully healthy. The final action-only continuation removes them and reaches99 resting bays; it does not schedule unconditional collapse.
remainingApproximations: Coarse structural assemblies and conservative box contacts; no all-pairs moving slab/chunk solver.
Chunks share motion and bounds span gaps; rubble overlap and some long-lived connected activity remain possible.
Water is a short-lived momentum-carrying particle burst, not a fluid-volume solver.
Steel bending, concrete/rebar failure, dust volumes and a whole-tower lean remain stylized or partial.
History grows without eviction;91 simulation seconds is the longest tested run, and payload excludes object/renderer/event memory.
The original capture sequence ends with a still-moving supported tank, but zero measured overlap; resting is not forced on moving support.
Full uninterrupted normal-speed viewing of every delivered clip was not completed. Selected frames, decode checks and cadence telemetry are the available playback proof.
